minerwk.configuration.title: Mine-RWK
habilidade.minerwk.teste_golpe.desc: Instant strike in a short area.
habilidade.minerwk.teste_carga.desc: Hold to charge; more power, more damage and shake.
habilidade.minerwk.gojo_azul.desc: Creates a point of attraction that pulls in and crushes everything.
habilidade.minerwk.gojo_vermelho.desc: Hold to charge; the orb explodes with strong repulsion.
habilidade.minerwk.gojo_infinito.desc: For 6 s, attacks and projectiles never reach you. Drains energy.
habilidade.minerwk.gojo_roxo.desc: Merges Blue and Red into a mass that erases its path.
habilidade.minerwk.gojo_vazio_infinito.d: Domain expansion: everyone inside is paralyzed.
habilidade.minerwk.gojo_roxo_200.desc: Full incantation: Hollow Purple at double power. Needs full energy.
